cousin of CMY, solicitor, brother of [Charlotte Fortescue Yonge](/person/1588)

He married (1883) Emma Caroline Isabel (or Isabella) Sherlock (1861-1917). Burke\'s Landed Gentry calls him John Henry Yonge.
